Title: Kunal and the Family

Cast

1. Kunal - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Anjali - 41 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Sanjay - 42 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Anjali and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "Anjali, what's the plan today?"

[Kunal searches for his lost ball.]

Sanjay (laughing): "One more time!"

[Kunal nods.]

Anjali (gently): "Yes, of course."

[It starts to rain.]

Kunal (surprised): "One more time!"

[A light drizzle begins.]

Kunal: "Really?"

Scene 2: The kitchen - Day

[Kunal stands in the kitchen. Anjali and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "What a nice place."

[Kunal makes tea for everyone.]

Sanjay: "Yes, of course."

[Kunal chops onions for the curry.]

Sanjay (laughing): "One more time!"

[Kunal washes the dishes after dinner.]

Kunal: "I knew it!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Anjali and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "Kunal, look over here."

[Kunal reads a storybook.]

Sanjay: "That was fun!"

[Kunal studies for his exam.]

Anjali: "That was fun!"

[Kunal does his homework at the table.]

Kunal: "Let's see."

[Kunal talks to his father on the phone.]

Sanjay: "Yes, all right."

[Kunal's phone rings and he answers it.]

Kunal: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Kunal types on his laptop.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Kunal watches cartoons on TV.]

Sanjay: "Kunal, look at this."

Scene 4: The bathroom - Day

[Kunal stands in the bathroom. Anjali and Sanjay stand near him.]

Kunal: "What a nice place."

[Kunal brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Anjali (surprised): "Sanjay, listen!"

[Kunal takes a quick bath.]

Anjali: "I really enjoyed today."
